From 9f1168cf263aab0474300f7118107f8ef73e7423 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2021 15:20:45 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] PCI: controller: PCI_IXP4XX should depend on ARCH_IXP4XX

The Intel IXP4xx PCI controller is only present on Intel IXP4xx
XScale-based network processor SoCs.

Add a dependency on ARCH_IXP4XX, to prevent asking the user about this
driver when configuring a kernel without support for the XScale
processor family.

Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/6a88e55fe58fc280f4ff1ca83c154e4895b6dcbf.1624972789.git.geert+renesas@glider.be
Fixes: f7821b4934584824 ("PCI: ixp4xx: Add a new driver for IXP4xx")
Signed-off-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
[lorenzo.pieralisi@arm.com: commit log]
Signed-off-by: Lorenzo Pieralisi <lorenzo.pieralisi@arm.com>
Reviewed-by: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>

diff --git a/drivers/pci/controller/Kconfig b/drivers/pci/controller/Kconfig
index 5e1e3796efa4..326f7d13024f 100644
--- a/drivers/pci/controller/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/pci/controller/Kconfig
@@ -40,6 +40,7 @@ config PCI_FTPCI100
 config PCI_IXP4XX
 	bool "Intel IXP4xx PCI controller"
 	depends on ARM && OF
+	depends on ARCH_IXP4XX || COMPILE_TEST
 	default ARCH_IXP4XX
 	help
 	  Say Y here if you want support for the PCI host controller found
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/pci/controller/Kconfig`**
   - Added a new dependency for the `PCI_IXP4XX` configuration option:
     - `depends on ARCH_IXP4XX || COMPILE_TEST`
   - This change ensures that the Intel IXP4xx PCI controller driver is only presented as an option when the architecture is set to IXP4XX or when compiling for testing purposes.

### Relationships

- The modification establishes a conditional dependency that prevents the PCI IXP4XX driver from being configured in kernels that do not support the Intel IXP4xx architecture. This is important for avoiding unnecessary configuration prompts for users who are not building for the XScale processor family, thus improving the configuration process and preventing potential build issues. The change is directly related to the previous commit that introduced the driver, ensuring that it is only relevant in appropriate contexts.

PCI: controller: PCI_IXP4XX should depend on ARCH_IXP4XX

Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/6a88e55fe58fc280f4ff1ca83c154e4895b6dcbf.1624972789.git.geert+renesas@glider.be
Fixes: f7821b4934584824 ("PCI: ixp4xx: Add a new driver for IXP4xx")
Signed-off-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
[lorenzo.pieralisi@arm.com: commit log]
Signed-off-by: Lorenzo Pieralisi <lorenzo.pieralisi@arm.com>
Reviewed-by: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>

Here is the root cause:
The Intel IXP4xx PCI controller driver was being presented as a configuration option in kernels that did not support the IXP4xx architecture, leading to potential confusion and build issues for users not targeting the XScale processor family. This was due to the lack of a proper dependency check in the Kconfig file.

Here is the patch:

 	depends on ARM && OF
+	depends on ARCH_IXP4XX || COMPILE_TEST
 	default ARCH_IXP4XX

```
Reason:
The absence of a dependency on `ARCH_IXP4XX` in the Kconfig file allowed the Intel IXP4xx PCI controller driver to be presented as a configuration option even in kernels that did not support the IXP4xx architecture, causing confusion and potential build issues.

The code statements that fix the bug are:

```
Reason:
By adding the dependency on `ARCH_IXP4XX`, the configuration option for the Intel IXP4xx PCI controller is now only presented when the kernel supports the IXP4xx architecture, preventing users from encountering issues when configuring kernels that do not target the XScale processor family.
